Provenance
==========

Origin: SYNTHETIC (hand-authored)
Date:   2026-05-21
Author: costa (B3 Phase 2 batch 2)

mp.weixin.qq.com is the single most cited source for Style H articles
(see references/writing-styles.md). Screenshot crops that include the
qrcode follow-button area waste vertical space and look like ads.

HOST_MAIN_SELECTORS["mp.weixin.qq.com"] lists:

  #js_content              the canonical article-body id
  .rich_media_content      the class form (same element gets both)

This fixture proves the selector binds to the body, NOT to the wider
.rich_media wrapper (which includes title + meta + footer qrcode) nor
the .qrcode_box decoy below the body.

Login-walled content is a B1 concern; selectors are identical
post-render, so this fixture covers the contract for that case too.
